trap.label: approximately of
trap.wrong: The median value is approximately of 40.
trap.why: Em português “aproximadamente de 40” é aceitável com preposição em algumas construções. Em inglês, roughly/approximately vêm diretamente antes do número.

fix.wrong: The mean is of 12 and the median are 10.
fix.right: The mean is 12 and the median is 10.

fix.wrong: Prices climbed to 3 points last year.
fix.right: Prices climbed by 3 points last year.

fix.wrong: The modal category be the youngest group.
fix.right: The modal category is the youngest group.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com roughly: “The mean is nearly 12.”
Reescreva com plateau: “Sales stopped rising.” (levelled off)
Reescreva com by: “The rate rose 2 points.”
